messages:
nina (head of comms): Quick alert  TechCrunch pinged us asking for a preview quote and the embargo time. They said an editor might run a blurb early if they get it.

leo (content): Our slate shows publish at 09:00 PT tomorrow. We definitely can't push earlier.

rajesh (product): Why would they want a quote? Did they ask for numbers?

mira (pr): (from PR) They asked for a 1-sentence CEO line + 1-line on methodology. No numbers.

amy (legal): If we provide anything, keep it high level and explicitly embargoed. I can clear a 1-liner but need it to avoid comparative claims.

nina (head of comms): Let's offer a neutral holding line and a short methods blurb. We should also include clear embargo language and a request not to publish raw tables.

press-bot: :inbox_tray: Email template queued to reporter (ID: 2026-03-23-CR-89).

leo (content): Draft holding line: "These benchmarks summarize work to improve inference latency and cost across common deployment patterns." Thoughts?

rajesh (product): Prefer: "These benchmarks summarize our recent efforts to improve inference latency and unit cost across common deployment patterns." Slightly more active.

amy (legal): Change "unit cost" to "per-token cost" to be precise.

leo (content): Updated: \"These benchmarks summarize our recent efforts to improve inference latency and per-token cost across common deployment patterns.\"

nina (head of comms): Methods blurb (one para) please so PR can paste.

rajesh (product): Methods blurb: "We ran end-to-end latency tests across multiple regions and model families using representative production prompts. Cost figures are estimated from tokenized workloads with batch-aware execution; routing and caching settings were held consistent across runs to ensure comparability."

leo (content): I'll combine quote + methods and send under embargo copy: 
```
Per embargo: Not for publication or attribution until 09:00 PT on <date>. The following quote and methodology are approved for use at embargo lift.
"These benchmarks summarize our recent efforts to improve inference latency and per-token cost across common deployment patterns."
Methodology: [paste blurb above]
```
\npress-bot: :white_check_mark: Sent to TechCrunch; reporter acknowledged and confirmed they will hold to embargo.

amy (legal): Small tweak: change "representative production prompts" to "representative prompts commonly used by our customers" to avoid implying exhaustive coverage. Approving otherwise.

rajesh (product): Done. Updated methods blurb now in email.

social-ops: Noted  will prep assets once blog link is live; holding social drafts.

nina (head of comms): Thanks team. If any outlet pushes to run early, escalate here and we'll route to exec comms. Closing unless we hear back
